- Tokyo (JST) is UTC+9
- Singapore (SGT) is UTC+8
- Sydney (currently AEDT due to DST) is UTC+11 (DST started in early Oct)

That DST shift is the usual cause of the "next-day" look when invites are created from a US calendar set to UTC or PDT — the hour offset can roll a late-night Sydney time into the next calendar day. We'll make the invite explicit with both local-time labels and UTC to avoid confusion.
